mapper.sql: select sd.id, sd.name, sd.enterprise_id, se.enterprise_name, sd.parent_id, sd.sort, sd.leader_user_id, su.nickname as leader_user_name, sd.phone, sd.email, sd.status, sd.create_time from system_dept sd left join system_enterprise se on se.id = sd.enterprise_id left join system_users su on su.id = sd.leader_user_id
